The '''Cloud City Core''' was an area of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], where most of its [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]] were located.

The [[Unidentified Bespin Podracing course|Bespin podracing course]] cut through this location, from the direction of [[Royal Park]].<ref name~"Kinect">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|dueled]] in the Core<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="ESB Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'' to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref>
